name: awesome-tmux
desc: A list of awesome resources for tmux

resources.name: tmuxcheatsheet.org
resources.desc: Interactive, searchable cheat sheet with copy-to-clipboard commands and a customizable prefix key

resources.name: Example tmux config
resources.desc: green_book: Example tmux configuration - screen + vim key-bindings, system stat, cpu load bar

resources.name: tmuxp
resources.desc: computer: tmux session manager and python library

resources.name: minimal-tmux-status
resources.desc: Minimal theme with only required information in status bar and prefix indicator. (changes only status bar)

resources.name: rose-pine
resources.desc: Soho vibes for tmux

resources.name: tmux-dark-notify
resources.desc: Make tmux's theme follow macOS dark/light mode.

resources.name: tomorrow
resources.desc: 5 flavors of Tomorrow theme based on specifications from Tomorrow Theme (_i.e._ _dark_/_blue_ and _light_).

resources.name: tmux-kanagawa
resources.desc: Dark colorscheme inspired by the colors of the famous painting by Katsushika Hokusai.

resources.name: gruvbox-tmux
resources.desc: A clean Tmux theme that follows the gruvbox colors

resources.name: tmux-oasis
resources.desc: Desert theme pack with 12 variants for every color of the rainbow and a dynamic statusline for all tmux modes.

resources.name: tmux-code-time
resources.desc: Tracks time spent in sessions. Displays session duration in your status bar.

resources.name: tmux-df
resources.desc: Show available disk space (output of df command)

resources.name: tmux-mullvad
resources.desc: Keep track of Mullvad VPN status.

resources.name: tmux-ludanta
resources.desc: What's playing

resources.name: tmux-packet-loss
resources.desc: Displays packet loss % if at or above the specified threshold level

resources.name: tmux2html
resources.desc: cat2: Render full tmux windows or individual panes as HTML

resources.name: kmux-status
resources.desc: Tmux plugin to render kubernetes context and other indicators on the status-line.

resources.name: muxile
resources.desc: View and control your tmux session from your mobile.

resources.name: tmux-autoreload
resources.desc: Watches your tmux configuration file and automatically reloads it on change.

resources.name: tmux-copytk
resources.desc: Multi utility rapid copy toolkit.

resources.name: tmux-devcontainers
resources.desc: Manage and interact with (Devcontainers)[https://containers.dev]

resources.name: tmux-floating-plugin
resources.desc: A popup floating terminal window in tmux.

resources.name: tmux-gh
resources.desc: Tmux plugin to fetch the github helper profile. Displays, the currently actively authenticated git username.

resources.name: tmux-grimoire
resources.desc: Customizable popup shells (aka shpells) driven by custom scripts.

resources.name: tmux-menus
resources.desc: Popup menus to help with managing your environment.

resources.name: tmux-modal
resources.desc: Execute complex tmux commands in just a few keystrokes with a modal mode that is designed to be efficient, easy to remember and comfortable.

resources.name: tmux-mouse-swipe
resources.desc: Switch Window or Session by clicking right mouse button and swiping.

resources.name: tmux-open-nvim
resources.desc: A plugin to help open files in a running instance of Neovim. Pairs well with tmux-fingers or tmux-open.

resources.name: tmux-fzf-open-files-nvim
resources.desc: A plugin that parses pane text for files for selection in fzf to open in neovim.
